source: can you make a game of you snipe zombies on the head. so they are standing still on a platform and you are higher and you have to snipe there heads off. it's kinda like practice

image_prompt.text: A raised sniper stand overlooking the target platform, reachable by exposed stairs
a flat target platform below and in front of the sniper stand, with clear unobstructed sightlines to it

layout_placement.text: stationary zombie targets standing in the open on the lower platform, spaced so each head is individually sightable

notes: Shape forced: none of Lane Network, Breach Sequence, or Open Battlefield describes a static firing range; Open Battlefield was the least-wrong pick because the map is one contiguous surface with no lanes.
No preset offered - the PvE Shooter preset carries a lane network, wave spawners, and interiors, none of which this practice range wants.
Borderline P5: the genre notes flag gallery shooters with no player movement as probably P5, but the prompt describes two real platforms at different heights, so it was built.

open_questions.ask: No look was stated - should the range read as a clean modern training facility, or as a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse site?
Is this scored (time, accuracy, headshot count) or purely free practice with no end condition?
How far should the shot be - a short 100-stud range, or a long-distance one several hundred studs out?

coverage_missing.ask: Should the range read as a clean modern training facility or a grim apocalypse site?
Is there scoring or a time limit, or is it endless free practice?
How long should the sniping distance be?

answers.ask: No look was stated - should the range read as a clean modern training facility, or as a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse site?
answers.answer: Make it a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse shooting range, with the zombies standing still on a platform below the player.

answers.ask: Is this scored (time, accuracy, headshot count) or purely free practice with no end condition?
answers.answer: Make it free practice with no end condition; the point is just practicing sniping zombie heads.

answers.ask: How far should the shot be - a short 100-stud range, or a long-distance one several hundred studs out?
answers.answer: Use a short 100-stud range so it stays simple and plainly playable as practice.
